title: multiPortOperatingPoint
description: Operating point template for multi-port components: components with three or more terminals or multiple windings, where each port carries its own voltage and current waveforms (e.g. MOSFETs, IGBTs, BJTs, transformers when described component-side). Structurally analogous to MAS's operatingPoint with excitationsPerWinding[], but uses a generic 'port' label rather than 'winding'. MAS keeps its own native shape for backward compatibility with the IEC standard candidate.

excitationsPerPort.description: List of per-port excitations. Each item ties a port label (e.g. 'gate', 'drain', 'source', 'anode', 'cathode', 'primary') to a full operatingPointExcitation.

portExcitation.description: Excitation applied to one named port of a multi-port component.
portExcitation.title: portExcitation

port.description: Identifier of the port this excitation refers to.

excitation.description: Voltage and current waveforms at this port.
